done_when: Those three tests approve their story the way real stories are approved before starting a task, and still test what they tested; no product code changes

findings.body: All three tests still fabricate approval instead of obtaining it through the real approval flow. This helper writes `status` and a locally calculated approval hash directly; `tests/test_codex_setup.py:159` does the same. Real approval goes through `forge hook approval`: `src/forge/approval.py:130–140` checks the cold read and client sign-off, records the approval event, and commits the resulting state. Calling `forge task start` afterward exercises task creation but does not satisfy the explicit requirement to approve stories the way real stories are approved. Use the approval-hook setup demonstrated in `tests/test_approval.py:23–34`, preserving the existing phase and doctor assertions.
